mission: Find cases where the interface clips, lies, traps, loses focus, desynchronizes, or becomes unreachable even when backend state is alive.
mindset: Treat the UI as its own state machine and attack transitions between visible states.
opening_moves: Navigate rapidly through the most stateful screens.

escalation_ladder.name: Focus
actions: Tab through controls and change focus during updates.

escalation_ladder.name: UI collision
actions: Combine geometry, focus, modal, and navigation stress.

signature_tactics.name: Geometry torture
actions: Sweep sizes/aspect ratios and toggle fullscreen.

signature_tactics.name: Focus theft
actions: Change focus during work and mix keyboard/mouse.

combination_rules: If UI desync changes underlying state, hand to State Breaker/Persistence Demon.
handoff_triggers: Visible state disagrees with actual state.
stop_conditions: Interaction would submit a real external action.
